label: AIVD 3.50 ATOM-EXPLORATION EXECUTION-QUOTA AUDIT
precise_statement: The design intent of the constant 4 remains NOT_RECORDED. Operationally, board.executed counts atom_* lease results since the firewall reset. The fourth such result makes executed >= max_executed. A fifth atom_* lease also lands before the next next_atom, so that call returns None at executed=5 while PRIMARY candidate MAPT(SLICE:1,2(TOK)) is waiting, occupancy is 45, and leftover is 8. The gate does not read the candidate key.

purpose.operational_effect: After four atom_* lease results since reset, next_atom returns None and no further atom body is dispensed.
not_used_as: atom-layer escalation flag (unlike IR/prim/ext exhaustion helpers)

sibling_caps.note: Siblings also mark the layer exhausted. The atom path only stops next_atom.

different_bound.effect: caps how many bodies plan() keeps; not the next_atom gate

code_path.reset: designer._maybe_firewall sets atom_synth.board.executed=0 immediately before provenance_firewall
code_path.increment: designer lease_result: if op startswith atom_, executed += 1, informative or not, no origin test
code_path.read: AtomSynthesizer.next_atom returns None if executed >= max_executed

resources.coupling: only inside next_atom, which consults executed and not budget, invent_cap, or the allocator

consumption_post_firewall.counts_as: lease that first makes executed >= max_executed
dispensed in the same batch while executed was 3, so its lease precedes the next next_atom

hypotheses.H17a: PARTLY SUPPORTED as an effect. The cap left a later PRIMARY unmaterialized. It is not an exploration-versus-exploitation quota; every atom_* lease counts.
hypotheses.H17b: NOT ESTABLISHED. No safety rationale for the constant. Not increased.
hypotheses.H17c: COUPLING OBSERVED. n_mat can be voided by a counter the allocator does not read. 'Incorrect' is not concluded.
hypotheses.H17d: CONSUMPTION OBSERVED. The leases that fill the cap are rediscoveries. No reserve exists for a never-materialized PRIMARY. No repair.
hypotheses.H17e: NOT SUPPORTED. The increment does not distinguish productive, rediscovery, or redundant work.
hypotheses.H17f: NOT A CONCLUSION. Necessity and a new policy are not established.
hypotheses.H17g: SUPPORTED. Five ceilings. Only max_executed is spent at the refusal.
hypotheses.H17-REJECT: Not needed for the operational effect. Required for the design intent of the literal 4.

counterfactuals.method: arithmetic on the observed lease list; not a planner replay; no model calls

CF4_ignore_rediscovery_leases.because: all five post-firewall consumers are independent_rediscovery

not_recorded: outcome of name-in-ops and _register had next_atom returned a body
first_blocking_predicate: AtomSynthesizer.next_atom: board.executed >= board.max_executed after post-firewall atom_* leases 1-5. Crossing lease is #4. Observed refusal is after #5.
